title: Header counts match the rows and cards listed, in every display
custom_preconds:
1. Sign in to the build under test as a dispatcher whose role has Work Orders view and Work Orders create and edit (check: Settings > Roles & Permissions > open the role > on the Work Orders card, View and Create & Edit are both ticked. The Admin role has both).
  2. In the top bar, choose the location you test in (e.g. "Heavy Duty"). Every technician and work order below belongs to this location.
  3. Use a desktop browser window at least 1024 px wide (the display switcher only shows at 1024 px and wider).
  4. The location has these eligible technicians (examples): "ZZAUTOTEST Ana Alpha", "ZZAUTOTEST Ben Bravo", "ZZAUTOTEST Cal Charlie".
    • A staff member counts as a technician when, in Settings > Staff > open the staff member > Edit Staff Member, they are Active, the Time Clock (clockable) setting is on, the role is neither Office nor Time Clock User, and they are enrolled at this location.
    • To add one: Settings > Staff > add a staff member with those settings (e.g. first name "ZZAUTOTEST Ana", last name "Alpha").
  5. How to create each work order below:
    • Work Orders > New Work Order > pick the customer (add it from the window if it does not exist, e.g. "ZZAUTOTEST Alpha Co") and any asset > Create.
    • On the work order page set Lead Technician to the technician named (leave it empty for an unassigned one).
    • Move it to the status named: a new work order starts as Estimate; approve the estimate for Approved; use the status control on the work order page for In Progress, Review (Ready for Review) and Complete; decline the estimate for Declined; Finance tab > Create Invoice for Invoiced; record a payment for the full amount for Paid. Set the lead technician before invoicing.
    • Write down each work order number as you create it (e.g. S1-801).
  6. Seed exactly these work orders (customer names start with "ZZAUTOTEST"):
    • Lead Ana: Alpha Co Approved, Bravo Co Approved, Charlie Co Estimate (3).
    • Lead Ben: Delta Co In Progress, Echo Co Invoiced (2).
    • Lead Cal: none (0).
    • No lead: Golf Co Approved, Hotel Co Estimate (2).
    • Total: 3 + 2 + 0 + 2 = 7.
custom_steps:
1. Open Work Orders from the top menu and click the All tab.
  2. Type "ZZAUTOTEST" in Search so only your test work orders show.
  3. Click List in the display switcher (the design tooltip reads "Table").
  4. Count the List rows.
  5. Click Tech View in the display switcher at the right of the toolbar (the design tooltip reads "By Lead Tech").
  6. Read each group header count and count the rows under each group.
  7. Click Board View in the display switcher (the design tooltip reads "Board").
  8. Read each column header count and count the cards in each column.
  9. Click Status and tick "Approved" only. Read the counts in Board View, then in Tech View, and count the List rows.
  10. Clear the Status filter and click the Estimates tab. Read the counts in Board View and in Tech View.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 4: List shows 7 rows.
  • Step 6: Tech View headers read Unassigned 2, Ana 3, Ben 2, Cal 0. Each count equals the rows under it, and 2 + 3 + 2 + 0 = 7 = the List rows.
  • Step 8: Board View columns read Unassigned 2, Ana 3, Ben 2, Cal 0. Each count equals the cards in the column, with the same total 7.
  • Step 9: Unassigned 1 (Golf Co), Ana 2 (Alpha Co, Bravo Co), Ben 0, Cal 0, total 3, in both views and the same as the 3 List rows.
  • Step 10: Unassigned 1 (Hotel Co), Ana 1 (Charlie Co), Ben 0, Cal 0 in both views. Each count always equals what is listed under it.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-10043; story SV-10045 (Story 2, Tech View); SV-10046 (Story 3, Board View); PRD Confluence 845185030, edited 7 Oct 2026 (status line "PRD v33"), S2-R12, S3-R12, read 8 Oct 2026. Inline PRD comment answer by Chris Ward, 25 Sep 2026 (count = work orders shown after filters).

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S2-R12: “Each group header shows the technician’s name, avatar, and a count of the work orders currently shown in that group, after the filter view and filters are applied, so the count always matches the rows listed.”
  • S3-R12: “Each column header shows the technician’s name, avatar, and a count of the work orders currently shown in that column, after the filter view and filters are applied, so the count always matches the cards listed.”
